name: Grilled Cu Chi veal
summary: Grilled veal, under more than one name. Báo Quốc tế says bò tơ nướng mọi and nướng mè. Tuổi Trẻ says bò nướng vỉ, bò nướng mọi, and bò tơ nướng lụi, and says some people grill at the table.
origin: Củ Chi. The names are not one recipe. Each name stays.
howToEat: Tuổi Trẻ says some people grill at the table, usually bò nướng vỉ or bò nướng mọi, and also lists bò tơ nướng lụi.
Báo Quốc tế lists bò tơ nướng mọi and nướng mè and does not describe the fire.
No price was printed. Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. Check on arrival
seoDescription: Grilled Cu Chi veal under the names nướng mọi, nướng mè, nướng vỉ, and nướng lụi. The price is Check on arrival.
